narrative: Email regarding an insurance policy bonus credit.

message.body: Annual Loyalty Bonus: Your life insurance policy accrued a bonus of ₹4,200. Check your eligibility status on our policy portal.

evidence.label: Insurance Agent Hotline
evidence.value: Agent advises checking bonus directly in the insurer's official mobile app.

consequence_text.safe: You checked your bonus status on your insurer's official mobile app.
consequence_text.unsafe: Rushing into unverified insurance claims carries phishing risks.

teaching_point: Check policy bonuses inside official app portals.
